fees.note: Single trip oversize $30 (= $15 + equal surcharge, SB 09-108).
Single trip OW or OS/OW = $30 + $10 per axle.
Chapter 6 Special single trip permit $250 above the maximum limits (17' W, 16' H, 130' L on 4-lane, 200,000 lb, 25' front / 35' rear overhang); replaces the single-trip permit.
Chapter 6 Special $250 (over 130' long; the limit is 120' on non-mountainous and 110' on mountainous two-lane highways).
Superload single trip permit $800 (over 500,000 lb, or double dolly over 15' wide).

restrictions.text: Night (sunset to sunrise): over 12' wide needs a pilot escort (front on two-lane, rear on four-lane highways); over 14' wide no night travel unless authorized by a Chapter 6 Special permit.

Holidays: no travel 6:00 a.m.-9:00 p.m. on Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day, and noon-9:00 p.m. on the Friday before Memorial Day and Labor Day (Friday/Monday also restricted when July 4 falls on a weekend).
Holiday and curfew hours restrictions apply (overweight-only loads up to 110,000 lb with legal dimensions are exempt from hours restrictions).

Weekday curfews (unless Chapter 6 Special): Denver area listed segments 6:00-9:00 a.m. and 3:00-6:00 p.m. Mon-Fri; Colorado Springs, Pueblo and SH 82 Aspen-Carbondale 7:00-9:00 a.m. and 4:00-6:00 p.m. Mon-Fri; Central City area only 3:00-11:00 a.m.; US 6 Clear Creek Canyon closed to extra-legal loads.

I-70 Morrison-West Vail: winter (Dec 1-Mar 31) no WB travel Fri 3-8 p.m. and Sat/Sun 7 a.m.-noon, no EB Sat/Sun 3-9 p.m.; summer (May 15-Sep 15) no WB Fri afternoon to 8 p.m. and Sat 8 a.m.-noon, no EB Sun 3-9 p.m. Eisenhower-Johnson Tunnels: over 13'11" high prohibited, over 11' wide must stop for tunnel permission.

travel.note: 2 CCR 601-4 404.3: Memorial Day, July 4 and Labor Day restricted 6 a.m.-9 p.m. (modeled as the whole day); other holidays are open.

notes: Legal: 102" wide, 14'6" high, 57'4" trailer with no overall limit; gross 80,000 lb on interstates but 85,000 lb on non-interstate highways (calculator uses 80,000). Legal overhang 4' front / 10' rear.

Escorts depend on the route color on CDOT's Pilot Escort and Oversize Restriction Map. Interstate modeled as 'white' (4-lane: rear escort or flashing yellow light over 15'); non-interstate modeled as 'green' two-lane (front over 13', front + rear over 15'). Yellow routes need front from 11'; blue routes front from 8'6" and front + rear from 11'; red routes need a Special permit for any overwidth.

Length escorts: over 85' on mountainous two-lane, over 110' on other two-lane (front), over 115' on four-lane (rear). Over 16' high: front escort with height pole; over 17' high: licensed signal contractor at signalized intersections.

Chapter 6 Special and Superload permits require at least one front and one rear pilot escort; CDOT may also require Colorado State Patrol escort, flaggers or standby pulling vehicles case by case (no fixed CSP trigger).
Superload flag here uses the Chapter 6 Special thresholds; CDOT's own term 'Superload' ($800 permit) is reserved for over 500,000 lb or double-dolly loads over 15' wide.
